preconditions.description: The length of the input string S must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be the longest palindromic substring of S.

postconditions.expression: any(S[i:i+len(stdout)] == stdout for i in range(len(S) - len(stdout) + 1))
postconditions.description: The output must be a valid substring of S.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == max(len(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output must be the longest palindromic substring of S.
